in_arabic.name: زيدن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زيدن مشتق من الجذر العربي 'زيد' الذي يعني الزيادة أو النمو. في السياق الإسلامي، يرتبط الاسم بزيادة في الخير والنمو الروحي. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الرزق الوفير والنعم الكثيرة.

in_urdu.name: زیدن
in_urdu.long_meaning: زیدن نام عربی جڑ 'زيد' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اضافہ یا ترقی. اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں، یہ نام اچھائی میں اضافہ اور روحانی ترقی سے وابستہ ہے. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں وافر رزق اور بہت سی نعمتوں کی علامت طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: ज़ैदन
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़ैदन नाम अरबी जड़ 'زيد' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है वृद्धि या उन्नति. इस्लामी संदर्भ में, यह नाम अच्छाई में वृद्धि और आध्यात्मिक उन्नति से जुड़ा है. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भरपूर आशीर्वाद और समृद्धि के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: زيدن
in_pashto.meaning: په خير کې زياتوالی او وده
in_pashto.long_meaning: زيدن نوم د عربي ريښو 'زيد' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې معنی يې د زياتوالي او يا نمو دی. په اسلامي سياق کې، دا نوم د خير او روحاني ودې زياتوالي سره تړلی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديزې په ډيره مېړه او بې شمېره نعمتونو د نښانې په توګه کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Zayden
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zayden is derived from the Arabic root 'زيد', meaning increase or growth. In Islamic context, it signifies an increase in goodness and spiritual growth. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote abundance and prosperity. Etymologically related to Quranic themes of spiritual and moral development, Zayden embodies positive connotations of augmentation and refinement.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zayden holds great significance in Islamic culture. It is rooted in the belief that each child is a gift from God, a blessing bestowed upon their parents. The name Zayden puts a deep emphasis on the concept of God's generosity and granting, and it invokes a sense of gratitude and appreciation among parents and loved ones.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zayden holds deep symbolism for it being a reminder of God's gift and blessings. Every time Zayden is called, it is a subtle yet powerful reminder that this being is a product of God's mercy and love. The name is a constant reminder of God's presence in one's life, and it inspires a deep sense of gratitude and humility towards the Creator.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hisham, Al-Sira al-Nabawiyya, 892 AD, mentions Zayd ibn Arqam as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who was present at the Battle of Uhud and witnessed the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.

Al-Bukhari and Muslim, Sahih, 860 AD, records a hadith where Zayd ibn Arqam relates that the Prophet Muhammad described heaven as having seven gates, one of which is called Sab'at Al-Jamal, which means 'mountain of abundance' and is for those who remember Allah a lot.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Zayden is a modern variant of the traditional Arabic name Zayd. It is gaining popularity in the Islamic community, particularly among parents who wish to give their children unique and meaningful names. Zayden is often associated with strength, generosity, and wisdom in Islamic culture. It can be written in Arabic as زیدان or زيدان. On Instagram, you may find beautiful calligraphy art of this name, along with photos of newborn babies bearing this name. On Pinterest, you can discover various ideas for baby showers, nurseries, and clothing items featuring the name Zayden. BabyCenter, a popular website for pregnant women and new parents, also includes Zayden in its list of trending baby names.

name_in_real_life.story: Layla Zayden, a teacher in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, shares that their name Zayden meaning "Given by God" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
